en.headline: FEHD issues pest notices after rat spotted again at HKUST canteen
en.dek: A large rat was filmed climbing conduits at a campus canteen on Thursday, the second sighting in under a month; the department found traces and issued notices to the university and operator.
body: A video posted on social media on Thursday showed a large rat climbing down conduits on a pillar inside a canteen at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, startling students who were eating nearby. It was the second rodent sighting at the campus in less than a month.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it had received one complaint about rodents at HKUST canteens between August and 11 November. After inspections it issued a pest elimination notice to one canteen operator in October requiring action by Friday. Following the latest sighting, officers inspected the canteens and nearby areas, found rat traces in shared seating areas and the canteen, and issued pest elimination notices to the university and the operator.

HKUST said it takes the matter seriously and does not rule out a link to construction activity at two nearby sites. The university has increased cleaning and disinfection, strengthened pest control at the location, inspected ceilings and facilities to seal possible entry points, and commissioned a professional contractor to review arrangements. It has required the operator to comply with food safety and environmental hygiene rules.
The department said it will continue to review the effectiveness of the measures and may prosecute if the notices are not complied with.

zh.headline: 科大飯堂再有老鼠出沒 食環署發消除通知
zh.dek: 周四影片顯示大型老鼠沿柱管爬行，不足一個月內第二次；署方巡查發現鼠跡，向大學及營運商發出消滅害蟲通知。
body: 周四社交媒體流傳影片，顯示香港科技大學一間飯堂內有大型老鼠沿柱上管道爬行，當時正在用餐的學生受驚。這是校園不足一個月內第二次出現鼠蹤。
食物環境衞生署表示，今年8月至11月11日期間接獲一宗關於科大飯堂鼠患的投訴。經巡查後於10月向其中一間飯堂營運商發出消滅害蟲通知，要求於周五前完成。最新影片流出後，署方人員巡查飯堂及附近範圍，在共用座位及涉事飯堂發現老鼠痕跡，遂向大學及營運商分別發出消滅害蟲通知。
科大回應指非常重視事件，不排除與附近兩個地盤的建築工程有關。大學已加強飯堂及附近清潔消毒，在出現位置加強害蟲防治，檢查天花及設施堵塞入口，並聘請專業承辦商檢討安排。校方亦要求營運商嚴格遵守食品安全及環境衞生規定。
食環署表示會繼續檢視措施成效，如未遵從通知可提出檢控。
